episodes.synopsis: Ryuusei is an avid robotics tournament player. Unbeknownst to him, Ryuusei is being considered to join an elite Federation task force. In what may be his last game, enemy units are detected and an explosion rocks the arena.
episodes.title: The Steel Ghost

episodes.synopsis: The battle between Ryuusei and the swarm of bug robots continues. For someone who is an amateur, what kind of talents does Ryuusei possess?
episodes.title: Awakening Power

episodes.synopsis: Ryuusei has to learn quickly that piloting his own real mecha is no longer a game. He must work as part of the team; one careless move can cost the lives of himself AND his teammates.
episodes.title: Third Man

episodes.synopsis: How will Ryuusei prove to the team and the military that they can depend on him?
episodes.title: Wings of Catastrophe

episodes.synopsis: The trio of Captain Aya Kobayashi, Ryuusei and Rai Branstein will now be called the SRX Team and the team will go on it's first major off-base mission.
episodes.title: Guest from the Other Side

episodes.synopsis: Chaos ensues as the Earth Federation tries to defend itself against the Granzon. Earth's mecha protectors go to battle against the various aliens who want retribution for the attack during the peace talks.
episodes.title: Blue Devil

episodes.synopsis: The EOTI Organization led by Prof. Bian Zoldark has started the new generation called "Divine Crusaders"--a group whose members want to defend humans against the aliens but feel the Earth Federation is in their way.
episodes.title: Divine Crusaders

episodes.synopsis: The war on its several fronts is not going well for the Federation, as Ryuusei has to learn, firsthand, about the casualties of war.
episodes.title: Steel Ark

episodes.synopsis: Preparations are underway to launch the Space Noah-Class all-purpose assault cruiser, the Hagwane. Meanwhile, the Divine Crusaders launch an attack on that very vessel.
episodes.title: Hagane`s Liftoff

episodes.synopsis: The Personal Troopers are shocked to find out that they are facing a new form of Armored Module, as well as an experienced group of pilots from the United Colony. Captain Minase of the Hagwane must decide to fight the Granzon or retreat.
episodes.title: The Elemental Lord of Wind

episodes.synopsis: Can both sides join forces to force the common enemy to retreat?
episodes.title: Masaki`s Choice

episodes.synopsis: Plissken is putting together a team as the strengths and weakness of Ryuusei, Aya and Kusuha come into play and their simulators run them through their paces.
episodes.title: Trap

episodes.synopsis: A transport vessel headed toward the Hagwane comes under fire by Armored Modules piloted by Divine Crusaders pilots Tomas and Tenzan, ultimately leading to a confrontation between Ryuusei and his "Burning PT" rival Tenzan.
episodes.title: Omen of the Battle

episodes.synopsis: Success in taking over satellite communications from Earth’s forces has given the United Colony Corps control of space. The Federation must send both assault carriers, and the Personal Troopers into an all-out battle against the United Colony Corps.
episodes.title: Operation Breakout

episodes.synopsis: The various Federation teams need to buy some time, even as a new battle arrives on the horizon. We learn the backstory of a United Colony Corps pilot who is part of the Elite Aggressors group who has a grudge against the Earth Federation Army.
episodes.title: One Strike from the Heavens

episodes.synopsis: The Earth Federation Army puts everything on the line against the Divine Crusaders.
episodes.title: Bian`s Last Request

episodes.synopsis: The war has pretty much ended with the defeat of Bian Zoldark but remnants of the Divine Crusaders continue to cause trouble as Adler Koch takes control.
episodes.title: Little Princess

episodes.synopsis: A gravitational anomaly is detected, something similar to what was found in meterorite #3, where technology used to create the super robots and new weaponry was first recognized. The Earth Federation goes on alert.
episodes.title: Ryuune, and Valsione

episodes.synopsis: The threat that Dr. Bian Zoldark has talked about comes to pass, as the alien Aerogaters' massive fortress, known as the White Star, appears. The aliens declare war on Planet Earth.
episodes.title: Evil Star Appears

episodes.synopsis: The remaining elements of the Divine Crusaders led by Adler Koch are trying to take advantage of the Aerogaters' attack on the planet. Koch launches an offensive to conquer Geneva, the Federation Army's nerve center.
episodes.title: Divine Crusaders (DC) of the Setting Sun

episodes.synopsis: The warriors from both sides display their doubts and feelings about the war's progression, even as new weapons appear on the battleground. Lives are lost and treachery prevails in the chaos.
episodes.title: Doubt

episodes.synopsis: The vessels attempt to combine for greater superiority in battle, and disaster ensures. A traitor is revealed, as several heroes fall or go missing. Things can't get much worse.
episodes.title: Gunpoint of the Betrayer

episodes.synopsis: Aerogater forces lay siege to cities all over the world as humanity’s forces gather to defend the planet. The Earth forces ready themselves, but they don’t stand much of a chance, with their mecha locked up and their pilots detained.
episodes.title: Day of Separation

episodes.synopsis: The Earth Federation Army and the United Colony Corps go into full-scale war mode against the alien Aerogaters. The decisive battle with the Aerogaters has begun, and a warrior comes into his own.
episodes.title: Combined power

episodes.synopsis: An epic battle is waged. Who will be the victors--the fleet from Earth or the Aerogaters?
episodes.title: Divine Wars
